Declared HS codes 292390, 330111 and 330190 were not observed in the visible rows; observed codes were 29052220, 33012590, 33012400, 30039021. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual observed codes (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Domestic supply evidence was not found in accessible public sources, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' — absence of evidence here reflects search-tool failure, not proof of no domestic sales.
